content: Sneha Roy asked Vikram Patel to confirm if her auto insurance policy had expired. Vikram confirmed it had expired due to non‑payment and that a renewal quote had been emailed. Sneha said she hadn't received any notification, so Vikram resent the quote and explained the renewal steps—click the email link, review terms, and pay online—offering further assistance. Sneha thanked him and said she would review the quote and contact him if she needs help.

action_items: Agent resent renewal quote to customer's email
Customer will review the quote and follow up if assistance is needed
